reviews.title: Like someone from Cyprus knows US motorcycle tests
Ok but not OK
reviews.text:
This App is not All in One for DMV. Even after selecting specific locale it still gives questions of unnecessary information which is not related to your DMV or that won’t come in your test wasting time. 

So many useless questions without any logic or proper reasoning that repeat throughout tests. 

Same answer changes to same question under logic less questions making you confuse yourself with what’s the right answer and why. 

I’ve had so much confusion after using this app than I was before. 

This App is just for reference but Do not follow it blindly. Use multiple other platforms and websites for preparation. 

All the best test takers.

reviews.title: Absolute waste of time
reviews.text:
App  is a waste of time. One question will give you the right answer. Then turn right around and the answer is something completely different even thought the wording and everything is exactly the same. The app also shows laws for other states that do not apply. Most of the questions that are wrong are about following distance, where to ride in the lane and when, and how to park against a curb just to name a few. You will be far better off going to the DMV and getting a operators manual and reading it. 

Ashamed of this company with this app. The CDL test was absolutely amazing and helped me pass but this motorcycle one is absolute garbage and I do not recommend this at all

reviews.title: Wording of questions
reviews.text: This app has some of the worst question wording i’ve seen in any test for any category. I can almost guarantee they used AI because not only will the wording purposely lead you to the wrong answer, it will give 3 answers that are right and one that’s wrong and you’re left get lucky and pick whatever right answer they chose for that question. On top of that it will constantly ask you questions for states you didn’t select that do NOTHING for you in the actual test. I absolutely do not recommend giving these people your money especially for 23 dollars a month. This app is a joke
